text:
tay: Pushed an experimental layout for the latency overview. Changes: compact presets row, sampling mini-control inline with the timeline, and a 'visible density' estimate under the chart. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz
omar: I like the density estimate. UX question: what wording? 'Approx. visible points' feels technical. Maybe 'Estimated visible events' or 'Shown datapoints (est.)'?
nina: Accessibility: color-only heatmap breaks for several color-deficiency sims. Recommend a hatch pattern or diagonal lines for the bottom two bands + an accessible label that reads 'low / medium / high density'.
tay: Good call. I experimented with subtle diagonal hatching for the two lightest bands. It maintains the gradient while being distinguishable in mono modes.
ux-bot: Design token note: use token --color-heatmap-1 and --pattern-heatmap-xs for consistency. See docs: https://design.redwood/tokens
omar: Touch target note: the inline sampling toggle is 28px right now which is too small for mobile. Let's enforce 44px min touch area but visually keep it compact with negative margin.
nina: For screen readers, add aria-describedby that points to a hidden string explaining the ratio and effect: e.g. '1 in 10 sampling reduces points to 1/10, may omit small spikes.' Also add aria-live polite on change.
tay: Implementation idea for sparkline in tooltip: pre-render 16x8 sprite on chart render and reuse in tooltip canvas; cheap and smooth. infra: That approach should be fine, just ensure the sprite atlas respects DPR scaling for Retina.
qa: Please add an e2e: open panel, toggle sampling, assert aria-live announced change and chart re-renders within 2s. Also test keyboard nav: Tab order should reach presets -> sampling -> apply.
omar: Copy suggestion for presets: use human phrasing: 'Last hour', 'Last 3 hours', 'Last day' (instead of 1h/3h/24h). Keeps it consistent with product docs.
tay: On keyboard order I tried Presets first then custom dates then Apply -> sampling. But product asked sampling before Apply so the setting applies immediately. Maybe show a small 'Re-run' CTA when sampling changes instead of changing order.
nina: Small a11y nit: legend labels need 3px padding above to avoid clipping when panel is collapsed. Also bump font-weight to 600 for contrast.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist added to the figma file. Tagging a11y reviewers.
tay: I'll iterate these changes, add the hatch assets, bump target sizes, and prototype the 'Re-run' toast. Will ping for a quick 5-person hallway test tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
